rules.statement: The Supreme Court has inherent and revisionary powers to review its own judgments, particularly when there is a violation of the principles of natural justice such as audi alteram partem.
rules.supporting_quote: "In so far as the petitioner is concerned there has been a violation of the principles of natural justice which makes it incumbent on this Court, despite technical objections to the contrary, to do justice."

meta.parties: Ganeshanantham v. Vivienne Goonewardene and Three Others
